page.name: Approval Process & Workflows
page.intro: The Communications Workflow is are internal processes for approving content for external-facing audiences. Documents are submitted and passed along the approval chain through supervisors, commissioners, and the Communications Team.
page.content:
Workflows are utilized through the Microsoft Dynamics app. They are submitted like a form that automatically sends your content to the appropriate parties for approval (typically your supervisor/director, then to a commissioner, and ultimately to the Director of Communications). 

Workflows are an approval process for content that the public will see, including:

  • Newsroom Articles
  • Priority Notices
  • Media Advisories
  • Media Releases

When preparing to submit content for any communications, involve your director/teams, and any other teams that may be involved. All content should be prepared in a Word document, proofread, and in quality condition before submission. Be sure to include any relevant images or attachments that accompany the content. 

(Example of Workflow)

Templates: For certain media, there are templates available to aid you in formatting. You can check the Communications Templates & Documents folder in Teams for the most updated versions.

Check with your supervisor if you will be using a workflow for any reason. Here is an in-depth tutorial on how to use and submit content on the workflow platform.
